title: R-GCN relation weights as Mirror views
hypothesis: A rank-2 relation coordinate over a shared R-GCN basis preserves relation-specific link ranking with less complete payload than free per-relation basis coefficients, including held-out relation IDs, while beating a native rank-2 factorized coefficient control.
mirror_coordinate: per-relation two-dimensional code and shared code-to-basis map
controls: ordinary R-GCN basis decomposition with four free coefficients/relation

development.selection_metric: heldout relation Hits@1/MRR and operator error, actual full relation-bank bytes

fresh.reason: no audit after exact native rank-2 coefficient-factorization alias

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes

success_gate: Heldout Hits@1 within 2 percentage points of independent matrices, >=25% full-bank byte savings vs both independent and free R-GCN coefficients, and strict frontier improvement over native rank-2 factorization.
failure_gate: Quality miss, <25% byte savings, or exact native coefficient-factorization alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Synthetic relation operators and entity vectors only.
Held-out relation codes are available side information and are charged.
No trained R-GCN benchmark or real knowledge graph claim.
